File photo of Robin Uthappa. He was appointed as the batting coach for the Mumbai Indians for the forthcoming IPL 2027. File | Photo Credit: The Hindu
Former India batter Robin Uthappa was on Friday (October 30, 2026) appointed the batting coach of Mumbai Indians ahead of the 2027 Indian Premier League season.
A member of India’s victorious squad at the inaugural men’s T20 World Cup in 2007, the 40-year-old Uthappa had played for MI in the inaugural season of the league.
In a X post, Mumbai Indians said “From being part of our very first season to returning with a wealth of experience! Robbie brings a sharp understanding of the game, great communication, and the clarity to guide youngsters! Welcome back to the Paltan, Robin!”
From being part of our very first season to returning with a wealth of experience! Robbie brings a sharp understanding of the game, great communication, and the clarity to guide youngsters! 💪 Welcome back to the Paltan, Robin! आपला new Batting Coach. 💙 https://t.co/OrIsO6dqgi
The five-time IPL champion also appointed Mitchell McClenaghan as the bowling coach for the IPL 2027 season. In the social media post, the franchise said, “So, when Paltan said, 'Get Mitch!’ We got Mitch back home. A fan favourite who wore the badge on his sleeve and personified the MI spirit. Welcome home, Mitchell McClenaghan.”
In another revamp, the franchise brought T.K. Dilip as the fielding coach. In an X post, Mumbai Indians said, “From three ICC titles with India to unforgettable medal ceremony moments, T.K. Dilip has won fans over with his energy and passion. Now, he brings that same intensity to the Paltan as our Fielding Coach!”
They also brought in Dhawal Kulkarni as Development Bowling coach. The social media post by Mumbai Indians said “Mumbai’s very own, a domestic stalwart, and now our Development Bowling Coach. Welcome back, Dhawal Kulkarni!”
Mumbai Indians already promoted its batting coach Kieron Pollard as head coach last week replacing Mahela Jayawardene.
